name: P2P Stream
description: Stream torrents straight into Jellyfin. Built-in torrent sources (no extra software), TMDB catalogs as libraries, search for any movie or show from the Jellyfin search bar, and Burst-style quality filters.

versions.changelog: Gelato-style settings page (tabs, catalogs table, New library folders, unsaved-changes bar); built-in sources incl. KickAss, BT4G, 1337x; Jellyfin search integration; Burst-style quality filters.
